scope: All packaged XML and literal Python screen definitions; shared runtime hook also covers inherited/default/plugin list row heights after desktop scaling. Horizontal/grid/spaced layouts are intentionally excluded.
backend: Actual pinned GUIComponent and MenuList Python classes; list painting/navigation backend is a host fixture, not physical receiver validation.
header_fix: Only title/path labels with less than two font heights are forced to a single line. Full title source text, descriptions and deliberately multiline titles are preserved.
